typedChecks.sourceText: ≥ 18 years of age on day of signing informed consent

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 - Note: Must have at least 1 tumor lesion with longest dimension of ≥ 10 mm...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST and lesion access requirements are subjective imaging and procedural judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: life expectancy > 12 weeks
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: adequate bone marrow, hepatic and renal function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ function is stated generally without specific numeric lab cutoffs in this clause.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: last dose of previous anticancer therapy (including investigational agents) ≥ 28 days, radiotherapy ≥ 14 days..., or surgical intervention ≥ 21 days prior to the start of treatment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout windows for prior therapies are complex rules not covered by simple typed lab or biomarker checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: willing to provide pre- and post-treatment tumor biopsy samples if medically feasible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to undergo a biopsy is a subjective procedural requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: prior treatment with recombinant interleukin-12 (IL-12)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior IL-12 is not an allowed prior_therapy_excluded drug name in the restricted list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 3 only: hypersensitivity to cemiplimab or any of its excipients or contraindications to cemiplimab per approved local labeling
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cemiplimab hypersensitivity applies only to a specific study part and is not a generalized exclusion.
